recipeDesc: Mid-cycle underwrite: normalized operating margin on a mid-cycle revenue base, valued at an exit EV/LTM-EBITDA multiple; reward/risk measured at SPOT.

assumptions.method: Legs are set on the consensus path: base is consensus FY26E, bull is consensus FY27E, and bear is the trailing twelve months less ~10%, carrying the negative forward revision breadth (FQ3 0 up / 14 down) forward rather than assuming it reverses. scenarios.name: bear
scenarios.reason: Secular case: AI substitution erodes the labour-arbitrage model; revenue -10% from the trailing twelve months (carrying the negative forward revision breadth, FQ3 0 up / 14 down, rather than assuming it reverses); margin below the FY25 worst (9.53%) as pricing grinds — floored by the variable-cost model, not collapsed; the multiple holds near the post-2022 trough (range low 4.26x, current 4.87x at the 2.6th percentile) — a secular decline earns no re-rating. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

scenarios.name: base
scenarios.reason: Margin is the post-2022 regime median of 11.10% less a ~60bps trajectory haircut: the regime's most recent year (FY25, 9.53%) is its worst and revision breadth is 0 up / 14 down, so the live-regime median likely overstates the forward mid-cycle. Explicitly not the 10-year blend (11.9%, which straddles the 2022 break), not the pre-war level (13.27%, a regime no longer representative), and not the consensus recovery (~15.6% operating income — the Street's base case is our bull). Revenue is consensus FY26E. The multiple sits below the 15.16x post-2022 median: the AI-substitution question earns a durable discount even at mid-cycle. [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]

scenarios.name: bull
scenarios.reason: The cyclical air-pocket resolves: the delivery rebuild completes and margin recovers toward but below the pre-war median (13.27%) and well below consensus (~15.6%); revenue is consensus FY27E; the multiple moves toward but stays below the post-2022 75th percentile (20.09x). [restated for external readability 2026-07-21; substance unchanged]
